technical.summary: Strong trend structure with EMA 50/200 golden cross and price above all major moving averages, but overbought oscillators (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R) and lack of fresh entry signals limit swing entry probability; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of existing position.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 84 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts, non-senior members
sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from non-senior members selling 5-6 months ago; neutral market fear/greed and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation or contradiction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (275.2) indicates extreme market stress, with earnings 84 days away providing moderate event risk; only DXY tailwind offers minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 50/200 golden cross with price above all major moving averages and ADX trending signal establish strong uptrend structure that could support continuation if overbought conditions resolve.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought oscillators (RSI 76.66, Stoch 87.92), zero fundamental conviction, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), weak money flow (CMF 0.0422), and absence of fresh entry triggers make this a high-risk entry into exhaustion rather than strength.
